_note: The general-provisions floor, expressed as rules so a new document type cannot silently ship below it. Mirrors drafting_policies.json -> defaults.hardening.baselineClauseIds. Unilateral instruments (Terms of Service, Privacy Policy) carry a narrower set and are excluded via applies_to_doc_types on the engine side. Filed under the 'contract' domain because every document type carries it; registry.addConstraints appends, so this coexists with contract.constraints.json.

//: These rules state a floor for a BILATERAL COMMERCIAL INSTRUMENT. A unilateral instrument is excluded because the floor is not merely unnecessary for it but wrong: a force majeure or counterparts clause in a promissory note would defeat Section 4 of the Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881, which requires the promise to be UNCONDITIONAL, and a notice clause in a power of attorney or a published policy has no counterparty to address.

These rules state the general-provisions floor for a BARGAIN. They are excluded by shape rather than by name: a notice, a sworn instrument and a published policy are not agreements and carry none of these clauses. The per-rule excludes_doc_types lists are retained for the individual agreements that legitimately omit one, such as a promissory note.
